instructions:
1. Set your feet on the footrests and press your thighs against the padded platform.
2. Place your hands behind your head and lean forward from the hips.
3. Raise your torso by extending your back.
4. As you rise, twist your torso to one side.
5. Lower under control and return to the start, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Twist smoothly and avoid jerking to protect the spine.
2. Keep the core braced throughout to support the lower back.
3. Exhale as you lift and twist, inhale as you lower.
4. Stop the extension when your torso is in line with your legs.

instructions:
1. Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel with both hands on the floor in front of you.
2. Keep your arms straight and your back flat.
3. Roll the wheel forward until your body forms a straight line, keeping your core braced.
4. Pull the wheel back to the start using your core.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the core braced to protect the lower back.
2. Move slowly and avoid using momentum.
3. Do not let the lower back sag at full extension.
4. Exhale as you roll out, inhale as you return.

1. Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel with both hands on the floor in front of you.
2. Keep your arms straight and your back flat.
3. Roll the wheel forward and to the left, keeping your core braced.
4. Pull the wheel back to the start using your core.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Roll out only as far as you can control to spare the lower back.
2. Keep the obliques tight to resist twisting.
3. Move slowly and avoid momentum.
4. Exhale as you roll out, inhale as you return.

instructions:
1. Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel with both hands on the floor in front of you.
2. Roll the wheel forward until your body forms a straight line from head to knees.
3. Hold this position with the core braced and the body stable.
4. Pull the wheel back to the start.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the spine neutral and do not let the lower back sag.
2. Brace the whole core to hold the position.
3. Keep the obliques tight to stop the torso twisting.
4. Breathe steadily during the hold.
